mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_symbol (revision_id, symbol_id, kind, fqn, simple_name, package_name, outer_symbol_id, visibility , is_abstract, is_final, is_static, properties_json, file_id, line_start, line_end) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{symbolId}, #{kind}, #{fqn}, #{simpleName}, #{packageName}, #{outerSymbolId}, #{visibility} , #{isAbstract}, #{isFinal}, #{isStatic}, CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb), #{fileId} , #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{lineEnd, jdbcType=INTEGER})

INSERT INTO analysis_method (revision_id, method_id, owner_symbol_id, name, signature, return_type, param_count, parameters_json , visibility, is_static, is_abstract, is_constructor, is_synthetic, synthetic_origin, properties_json , file_id, line_start, line_end) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{methodId}, #{ownerSymbolId}, #{name}, #{signature}, #{returnType}, #{paramCount}, CAST(#{parametersJson} AS jsonb) , #{visibility}, #{isStatic}, #{isAbstract}, #{isConstructor}, #{isSynthetic}, #{syntheticOrigin}, CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb) , #{fileId}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{lineEnd, jdbcType=INTEGER})

INSERT INTO analysis_field (revision_id, field_id, owner_symbol_id, name, type, visibility, is_static, is_final , is_synthetic, synthetic_origin, initializer_summary, file_id, line_start, line_end) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{fieldId}, #{ownerSymbolId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{visibility}, #{isStatic}, #{isFinal} , #{isSynthetic}, #{syntheticOrigin}, #{initializerSummary}, #{fileId} , #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{lineEnd, jdbcType=INTEGER})

INSERT INTO analysis_annotation (revision_id, target_kind, target_id, annotation_name, annotation_fqn, attributes_json, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{targetKind}, #{targetId}, #{annotationName}, #{annotationFqn}, CAST(#{attributesJson} AS jsonb) , #{fileId}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})

INSERT INTO analysis_reference (revision_id, file_id, from_kind, from_id, ref_kind, name, scope_text, arg_count, line_start, column_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{fileId}, #{fromKind}, #{fromId}, #{refKind}, #{name}, #{scopeText} , #{argCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{columnStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: SELECT kind AS "kind", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_symbol WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND NOT is_constructor AND NOT is_synthetic) AS "methods" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND is_constructor AND NOT is_synthetic) AS "constructors" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND is_synthetic) AS "syntheticMethods" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_field WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND NOT is_synthetic) AS "fields" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_field WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND is_synthetic) AS "syntheticFields" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_annotation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}) AS "annotations"
SELECT synthetic_origin AS "origin", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND is_synthetic GROUP BY synthetic_origin ORDER BY synthetic_origin
SELECT ref_kind AS "refKind", status AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_reference WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY ref_kind, status ORDER BY ref_kind, status

SELECT parse_status AS "parseStatus" , COALESCE(language_level, '') AS "languageLevel" , COUNT(*) AS "fileCount" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND language = 'JAVA' GROUP BY parse_status, language_level ORDER BY parse_status, language_level
mapper.sql: s.symbol_id AS "symbolId" , s.kind AS "kind" , s.fqn AS "fqn" , s.simple_name AS "simpleName" , s.package_name AS "packageName" , s.outer_symbol_id AS "outerSymbolId" , s.visibility AS "visibility" , s.is_abstract AS "isAbstract" , s.is_final AS "isFinal" , s.is_static AS "isStatic" , s.properties_json::text AS "properties" , s.file_id AS "fileId" , f.path AS "path" , s.line_start AS "lineStart" , s.line_end AS "lineEnd"
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
ORDER BY s.fqn, s.symbol_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT method_id AS "methodId" , name AS "name" , signature AS "signature" , return_type AS "returnType" , parameters_json::text AS "parameters" , visibility AS "visibility" , is_static AS "isStatic" , is_abstract AS "isAbstract" , is_constructor AS "isConstructor" , is_synthetic AS "isSynthetic" , synthetic_origin AS "syntheticOrigin" , line_start AS "lineStart" , line_end AS "lineEnd" FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND owner_symbol_id = #{symbolId} ORDER BY line_start, signature

SELECT field_id AS "fieldId" , name AS "name" , type AS "type" , visibility AS "visibility" , is_static AS "isStatic" , is_final AS "isFinal" , is_synthetic AS "isSynthetic" , synthetic_origin AS "syntheticOrigin" , initializer_summary AS "initializer" , line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_field WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND owner_symbol_id = #{symbolId} ORDER BY line_start, name

SELECT a.target_kind AS "targetKind" , a.target_id AS "targetId" , a.annotation_name AS "name" , a.annotation_fqn AS "fqn" , a.attributes_json::text AS "attributes" , a.line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_annotation a WHERE a.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND (a.target_id = #{symbolId} OR a.target_id IN (SELECT method_id FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND owner_symbol_id = #{symbolId}) OR a.target_id IN (SELECT field_id FROM analysis_field WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND owner_symbol_id = #{symbolId})) ORDER BY a.line_start, a.annotation_id

SELECT r.from_kind AS "fromKind" , r.from_id AS "fromId" , r.ref_kind AS "refKind" , r.name AS "name" , r.scope_text AS "scope" , r.arg_count AS "argCount" , r.status AS "status" , r.line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_reference r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND (r.from_id = #{symbolId} OR r.from_id IN (SELECT method_id FROM analysis_method WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND owner_symbol_id = #{symbolId}) OR r.from_id IN (SELECT field_id FROM analysis_field WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND owner_symbol_id = #{symbolId})) ORDER BY r.line_start, r.column_start, r.reference_id
